findings.original_problem: The proof quantifies its Hom comparison only over A rather than D(A), and leaves the descent of the non-exact termwise left adjoint implicit.
findings.correction: Quantify over D(A) and specify that the termwise functor inverts quasi-isomorphisms after the Verdier quotient. Its exact inverse and counit maps are proved in the editorial note.
findings.limits: The theorem is valid. No assertion that its left adjoint is exact is added.
